answer: Payroll attestation binds each agent to one employed person. The operator links a payroll provider, which signs a statement that an active employee record exists; validators verify that signature and keep a salted hash of the employee number, so one record backs one identity. A nurse at the Willow Street clinic gets one seat, not ten. Extra identities need extra real staff paid wages and taxes every month, which splitting keys cannot fake. Renewal is rechecked at the dawn of each quarter. Limit: freelancers lack payroll, so this should be a bridge used beside other checks.
